patterns.message: Import a Node built-in with the `node:` prefix: the published dist keeps the specifier, and Deno resolves no other.
Code in @bamboocss/shared can end up in styled-system/helpers.mjs, which runs in the browser: import no Node built-in here, with or without `node:`.
